release: Preview Failure Classification & Video Thumbnail Telemetry
name: Preview Failure Classification & Video Thumbnail Telemetry
changes: Splits previously generic preview_failed thumbnail errors into specific permanent/transient classes so immediate segment/media/safety/decode failures are not treated as blind retry candidates.
Adds request-paired client/server transport timing, backend phase timing, failure counters, and endpoint concurrency telemetry for video thumbnails without changing video concurrency.
Preserves the proven five-request browser image-thumbnail HTTP admission gate and provider/NNTP connection behavior from v3.6.65.
Preserves v3.6.62 progressive header reuse, v3.6.63/v3.6.64 name-resolution rendering, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation behavior.
regression_guards: Known permanent media/segment/safety/decode failures remain non-retryable; genuinely transient provider/segment-fetch failures remain retryable.
Video telemetry must be observational only: no changes to provider allocation, video thumbnail concurrency, preview worker count, decoder workers, or sample size.
Browsing telemetry schema 6 preserves all schema 5 image admission, paired transport, resolver batching, and endpoint concurrency fields while adding video endpoint concurrency/phase coverage.
Image HTTP admission remains capped at five and SAB 5.1.2, terminal-history schema 3, Discover, Smart Import, and Automation semantics remain unchanged.
release_name: Preview Failure Classification & Video Thumbnail Telemetry
